notes: τοὺς ἄρτους τῆς προθέσεως is taken as article + a two-token compound unit for *showbread*, aligned under rule 35's test since *-bread* and *show-* answer to the two lexemes; leaving προθέσεως unrepresented and giving *showbread* to ἄρτους alone remains defensible.
The intervening τῆς stays its own unrepresented unit on rule 93's reasoning, no part of the fused English word answering to it.
